levelRule: Level-based games need at least 20 authored levels with level select through env.progress.

findings.observation: A fuzz run over 22 shifts x 30 seeds found 219 stock losses and 0 false ones (5 false on shift 22 the round before). The stock check now computes the exact best ticket cover when the greedy count predicts a loss.
Real stock losses still fire promptly (for example shift 3 with three tomatoes wasted ends at 28-30 s), while shifts with one or two items wasted can still be cleared.

openNotes: The source file is about 2300 lines, over the 800-line soft ceiling, in line with other level-heavy games.
The prompt line effectively solves each shift for a player who follows it; a follower that never presses X still loses every junction shift.
Browser note: the green reach bar marks the prompted station, but Space uses whichever station is nearest, so a chef standing off-centre between two crates can take from the wrong one.

findings.observation: A bot that ignores the guide and prompts no longer clears most late meadows; a greedy bot clears 8 of the 16 late meadows.
Following prompts no longer leads into a sting: 0 stings in 1941 literal-follower runs at lag 0 and 0.25 across 14 moth meadows and 30/60/120 Hz.
The trail self-crossing check no longer costs about 10 ms per frame on long trails.
Fly pairs that one loop could catch were moved apart, and a loop too wide to close gets a warning.

Wait and back-away can no longer swap within 0.5 s; no wait/flee ping-pong shorter than 0.5 s on meadows 11, 18, 23 and 24. The worst count was 3 wait/flee-related changes in one second (meadow 23 stalker lure), accepted because every lower cap tried delayed a warning into a sting, a cut or a deadlock.

openNotes: At lag 0.25 the reviewer saw 3 lantern cuts in about 650 literal-follower runs (meadows 17 and 23); no stings.
Meadow 11 shows a 0.2 s walk line between two real waits, shorter than a reaction time.
Longest forced wait is 8.7 s on meadow 19, 12.1 s on 23 and 9.3 s on 24; dawn margins stay above 15 s.
Casual-player wins are lowest on meadow 6 (24/30) and meadow 23 (26/30).
